name: Zoltan Kiss
bio:
Zoltan's path to motorsport was unconventional, initially finding success as a mechanical engineer specializing in fluid dynamics. His analytical skills and problem-solving acumen quickly caught the eye of a small Formula 3 team, where he transitioned from engineering to race strategy. He spent several years honing his skills in data analysis and race management, demonstrating a talent for extracting maximum performance from limited resources.

His approach as a Sporting Director is deeply rooted in data-driven decision-making. Zoltan believes in empowering his team with clear objectives and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. He's known for his meticulous preparation and his ability to remain calm and focused even in the most chaotic race situations. He is also known to mentor younger members of the team, guiding them to be better at their respective roles.

What sets Zoltan apart is his ability to bridge the gap between the technical and the human aspects of motorsport. He understands that the best strategies are only effective if they are executed flawlessly by a motivated and cohesive team.

physical.description: Zoltan is of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with race data.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Drinks black coffee, precisely at 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM sharp.
